composition.serve_who: This sheet (108-01-515-001 "RAW WATER SYSTEM SCHEMATIC") is the raw-water side of the vessel's cooling system: it shows the seachest intake, strainers, main cooling seawater pumps, CPP seawater pump, main system heat exchangers (port/stbd), hydraulic pumps heat exchanger, pitch control heat exchanger, port/stbd generator raw-water circuits, aircon/watermaker seawater strainers, cathodic protection unit, and hull thru-hull fittings. Titled "SEACHEST 001-01" box and "Main Cooling Seawater Pump (MCSWP-P/S)", "CPP Seawater Pump (CPSWP)" labels tie directly to register raw-water-system nodes. Per engineer correction, the galvanic unit is TECNOSEAL not Cathelco as printed. Generators (Cummins QSB4.5) and CPP/Hundested sterngear equipment appear only as raw-water consumers (their own control/electrical facts live on other sheets/nodes). The bottom-left general-arrangement inset (ACTM/BEL/ESS/MPCS/EDN/MAPS boxes) is BAE hybrid-electric equipment layout, NOT part of the raw-water fluid system — it shares the sheet only as a plan-view location reference and has no raw-water piping connection drawn to it; those items get no fluid-scenario facts here.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Grundfos Main Cooling Seawater Pumps (Port + Stbd)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM item 013 x2 'MAIN COOLING SEAWATER PUMP' GRUNDFOSS CME 10-1, tagged 013-01 (MCSWP-P) and 013-02 (MCSWP-S) on the schematic, each feeding its own Main System Heat Exchanger.

functions.label: Port main cooling seawater pump (MCSWP-P, item 013-01)
functions.what_it_does: Draws seawater from the seachest main branch manifold, through NO valve 007-07, boosts it through the port Main System Heat Exchanger circuit, discharging via NO valve 007-08 back toward the main branch / overboard, cooling the port main system (coolant circuit) heat exchanger 010-01.

flow_scenarios.path: Seachest -> main branch manifold -> 2" NO valve -> MCSWP-P (013-01) -> NC solenoid 018-02 branch / NO valve 007-08 -> pipe th40/th51 -> Main System HX Port (010-01) -> flow switch FS(016-01) -> seawater outlet below DWL
Flush connection point on main branch manifold via 1" valve -> circuit reversed through quick-couplers (item 017) on heat exchanger 010-01 to remove fouling (per Note 3)

functions.dry_data: Centrifugal variable-speed pump, 230V AC 50Hz 1-ph, 18.9kg unit weight, item 013-01

functions.label: Stbd main cooling seawater pump (MCSWP-S, item 013-02)
functions.what_it_does: Mirror of port pump: draws seawater from seachest main branch, through NO valve 007-05, feeds stbd Main System Heat Exchanger (010-02), discharge via NO valve 007-06.

flow_scenarios.path: Seachest -> main branch manifold -> 2" NO valve -> MCSWP-S (013-02) -> NC solenoid 018-01 / NO valve 007-06 -> pipe th40/th25 -> Main System HX Stbd (010-02) -> flow switch FS(016-02) -> seawater outlet below DWL
Flush connection via quick-couplers on HX 010-02 per Note 3

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM item 014 'CPP SEAWATER PUMP' CALPEDA BCM 20/A, tagged 014-01 on schematic, dedicated to the Pitch Control Heat Exchanger circuit.

functions.label: CPP seawater cooling pump (CPSWP, item 014-01)
functions.what_it_does: Supplies seawater cooling to the Pitch Control Heat Exchanger (012-01), which cools the Hundested VP4 FR-HP pitch control hydraulics and the shaft seal/sterntube bearing circuit.

flow_scenarios.path: Seachest -> branch -> NO valve 005-06 -> CPSWP (014-01) -> NO valve 005-05 -> pipe th25 -> Pitch Control Heat Exchanger (012-01) -> seawater outlet below DWL
Priming line from fresh water supply ref DWG 108-01-510-01 feeds into suction side ahead of pump per sheet annotation

functions.dry_data: 2900rpm, 6 bar max, H max 12.3m, single-phase 230V AC, item 014-01

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Bowman / Funke Heat Exchangers (Main System Port+Stbd, Hydraulic Pumps, Pitch Control)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM items 010 (MAIN COOLING SYSTEM HEAT EXCHANGER, FUNKE, x2), 011 (HYDRAULIC PUMPS HEAT EXCHANGER, BOWMAN), 012 (PITCH CONTROL HEAT EXCHANGER, BOWMAN) all sit on the raw-water schematic as coolant/seawater plate or shell heat exchangers; grouped as the raw-water-cooled heat exchanger roster since no more granular per-function node exists beyond this shared BOM family.

functions.label: Main System Heat Exchanger - Port (010-01)
functions.what_it_does: Plate & Frame heat exchanger cooling the port main coolant circuit using raw seawater from MCSWP-P.

flow_scenarios.path: MCSWP-P discharge -> 3-way valves 019-01/019-02 (Note 3) -> HX 010-01 seawater side -> outlet below DWL

key_components: 3-way L-port ball valves 019-01/019-02 (flush/select function per Note 3)
functions.dry_data: Plate & Frame, 40kW Heat Dissipation, item 010 (Funke FP-09-29-2-NH)

functions.label: Main System Heat Exchanger - Stbd (010-02)
functions.what_it_does: Plate & Frame heat exchanger cooling the stbd main coolant circuit using raw seawater from MCSWP-S.

flow_scenarios.path: MCSWP-S discharge -> 3-way valves 019-03/019-04 (Note 3) -> HX 010-02 seawater side -> outlet below DWL

functions.label: Hydraulic Pumps Heat Exchanger (011-01)
functions.what_it_does: Shell & Tube exchanger cooling the hydraulic motors/pumps circuit; raw water side branches off the main cooling seawater loop (per drawn dashed th25 line to NC valve 007-09).

flow_scenarios.path: Branch off main cooling seawater loop -> NO valve 005-03 -> HX 011-01 -> NC valve 007-09 -> rejoin common return line th25

functions.dry_data: Shell & Tube, 3.2kW Heat Dissipation, item 011 (Bowman EC80-3875-1-CO)

functions.label: Pitch Control Heat Exchanger (012-01)
functions.what_it_does: 3/4" plate exchanger cooling the Hundested VP4 pitch control hydraulics and shaft seal circuit, fed by the CPP seawater pump.

flow_scenarios.path: CPSWP discharge -> HX 012-01 -> seawater outlet below DWL; coolant side loops through shaft seal / sterntube bearing / pitch control hydraulics

functions.dry_data: 3/4" Water In/Out, 3/4" Oil In/Out, 8kW Heat Dissipation, item 012 (Bowman EC100-3875-3)

equipment_groups.equipment_name: ifm Raw Water Sensors (Flow Switches / SCU monitoring points)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Flow sensors item 016 (x2, TBD make) and SCU monitoring symbols shown at each pump/HX pair are the raw-water instrumentation roster; grouped to the sensors node since the BOM/legend defines them as sensing devices distinct from the pumps/HX they protect.

functions.label: Flow sensors (016-01 port, 016-02 stbd)
functions.what_it_does: Monitor seawater flow downstream of each Main System Heat Exchanger to confirm adequate cooling flow to the SCU/monitoring system.

flow_scenarios.path: Inline on discharge of HX 010-01/010-02 before main branch return; low-flow signal reported to SCU

functions.label: SCU monitoring points (raw water)
functions.what_it_does: System Control Unit taps positioned at each main cooling pump, CPP pump, and generator coolant circuit to report raw-water system status.

flow_scenarios.path: Monitoring tie-in only, no fluid path — SCU symbol adjacent to MCSWP-P, MCSWP-S, CPSWP and coolant circuits

functions.dry_data: Legend symbol only, no BOM row

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Titled box 'SEACHEST 001-01' with BOM item 001 'SEACHEST' (SWS CUSTOM, see drawing for details) is the shared raw-water intake infrastructure serving all seawater pumps on this sheet.

functions.label: Seachest intake distribution (001-01)
functions.what_it_does: Provides raw seawater intake below DWL for all cooling and utility seawater pumps aboard: main branch manifold feeds main cooling pumps, CPP pump, generator raw-water pumps, aircon and watermaker strainers via dedicated thru-hull valves and strainers.

flow_scenarios.path: Seawater inlet below DWL -> 3" NO valve -> seawater strainer -> main branch manifold -> 2" NO valve branches to MCSWP-P / MCSWP-S suction

flow_scenarios.state: normal intake, secondary strainer branch (galvanic-protected seachest)
flow_scenarios.path: Second seawater inlet below DWL -> 3" NO valve -> seawater strainer -> feeds Cathelco/Tecnoseal control zone and remaining branch manifold valves
Flush connection point (1" valve) allows fresh-water flush of seachest branch to remove fouling

key_components: 2x seawater strainers (item 002, Guidi SRL Art 1166 Strainer 1.5")
thru-hull ball valves (items 006/007/008, 1"/1.5"/2" G I Trade Options)
functions.dry_data: SWS Custom seachest assembly, item 001; see DWG 108-01-504-002 for thru-hull fitting details

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Sheet shows box labelled 'CATHELCO GALVANIC PROTECTION CONTROL UNIT' item 009-01 inside the seachest zone (BOM: CATH-NANOSYS SEA CHEST NANO 3 SYSTEM). Per engineer's established correction, this vessel's galvanic control is actually TECNOSEAL, not Cathelco as printed — attach to the corrected node.

functions.label: Galvanic protection control unit (item 009-01, printed as 'Cathelco' — actually TECNOSEAL per engineer correction)
functions.what_it_does: Provides cathodic/galvanic protection control for the seachest and hull fittings; sits within the seachest zone monitoring the seawater system for galvanic corrosion protection.

flow_scenarios.state: n/a - electronic control device, no fluid path
flow_scenarios.path: Located inside seachest box; no seawater pipe drawn through the unit itself

functions.dry_data: BOM description 'Sea Chest Nano 3 System' printed as CATHELCO — engineer correction: actual make is TECNOSEAL

facts: Title 'RAW WATER SYSTEM SCHEMATIC', drawing 108-01-515-001 Rev A, dated 24 Oct 2022.
To be read in conjunction with DWG 108-01-515-002 'Cooling Water System Schematic' (coolant/glycol side).
Thru-hull valves detailed separately in DWG 108-01-504-002 'Thru-Hull Fittings Below & Near DWL'.
Note 3: Quick couplings on main heat exchangers (item 017) allow flushing of seawater circuit to remove fouling.

Pipe legend distinguishes seawater metallic pipe (blue solid), seawater flex pipe (green), coolant metallic/flex, vent/breather flex (red dashed), hydraulic oil flex (orange), fresh water cold (blue dashed).

Pipe details table lists sea water hoses (mw19/25/32/38/51, EPOM rubber steel spiral, Vetus Maxwell) and fire-resistant EASYFLEX hoses (th25/30/35/40/45/51, Iberica de Mangueras Thor) up to 7 bar rating.

Raw Water System Pump Data table: STBD/PORT generator raw water pump (Sherwood P2709-01) 193 l/min @ 2500rpm, 0.3kW; Main cooling circuit seawater pumps (Grundfos CME10-1) 200 l/min, 1.1kW; Controllable pitch seawater pump (Calpeda BCM20/A) 80 l/min, 0.37kW.
Minimum flow note (near CPP heat exchanger callout): minimum flow 22.5 l/min, max pressure 1.2 bar (0.6-0.7 bar sufficient) — suitable pressure/flow regulators + gauges may be required.

80L FWD BOILER / 80L AFT BOILER heat exchanger callouts at far right/left edges - these are coolant-side glycol loop items per DWG 108-01-515-002, only their internal heat exchanger tie-in is shown here as a stub with no seawater path drawn

Watermaker units (ref DWG 108-01-510-001) and Aircon system (ref DWG 108-01-590-001) seawater strainer/valve stubs (items 003-01/003-02, 004-01/004-02) - these strainers/valves feed those OTHER systems' raw-water need but the pumps/units themselves are detailed on their own referenced sheets, not this one; kept as thru-hull stub facts only, not elaborated as equipment functions here to avoid duplicating 510/590 node data

Port/Stbd Generator Cummins QSB4.5 coolant circuit boxes - the generator itself and its coolant loop is proper to 610-cummins-qsb4-5 node; raw water side (Sherwood pump per Pump Data table) is a generator-integral pump not separately tagged in BOM, so left as infrastructure fact rather than forcing an equipment function without a clean BOM tag

Duplicate 'BREATHER TO RUN INTO E-R VENT BOX REF: DWG 108-01-508-001' callouts (appear 6x) - vent routing reference repeated at each anti-siphon/breather point, single fact captured, remainder discarded as repeat
uncertainties: Flow sensor (item 016) make/model listed as 'TBD/TBD' in BOM — actual manufacturer not yet specified on this sheet.
Quick-coupler (item 017) make listed as '#N/A' in BOM — manufacturer not given.

The exact drawn connectivity of the CPP priming line from fresh water supply (ref DWG 108-01-510-01) into the CPSWP suction is annotated by reference only; the tie-in point is not fully traceable within this sheet's crop.

Generator raw-water (Sherwood P2709-01) pump is listed in the Pump Data table but not given an explicit item tag / BOM row on this sheet, so it is recorded as infrastructure data rather than an owned equipment function.

The seachest's dual strainer/manifold arrangement (upper vs lower valve banks in the SEACHEST 001-01 box) is not clearly differentiated in the extraction as to which serves which pump exclusively — treated as shared intake infrastructure.
